Bug_Details:
Scope annotation on implementation class of AssistedInject factory is not allowed Classes that AssistedInject factories create may not be annotated with scope
annotations, such as @Singleton. This will cause a Guice error at runtime. See
this bug report
for details.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the code by keeping the @Singleton annotation on the MyClass implementation class, which is not allowed when using AssistedInject in Guice. This will cause a runtime error if the code were to be executed with Guice.
